## Summary

Append-only, evidence-backed transition memory plus a deterministic, bounded current
view — all advisory. Nothing here writes the control ledger; `LEDGER.md` CURRENT STATE
and the DEFERRALS compatibility cells remain the authority.

- **`obligation-event/1`** (`docs/build/reports/obligations/events.jsonl`) — one event
  per line: `event_id (<obligation>:e<seq>)`, `kind` (migration|transition),
  `expected_previous_event` chaining, from/to status, `owner`/`landing`/`backlog_home`,
  `evidence_refs`, fixed `observed_at`/`recorded_at` inputs, `source_commit`, and on
  migration events `anchor{row_line, row_sha256, parser_status, prose_terminal,
  interpretation}`. All 89 DEFERRALS rows carry exactly one anchor preserving the raw
  digest — old values survive cell updates forever.
- **`coverage-assessment/1`** (`coverage_assessments.jsonl`) — scoped verdicts per
  `(requirement_id, domain)` over the five evidence domains; `supersedes` forms a
  single-headed chain per scope; historical `COVERAGE_MATRIX.csv` rows are preserved
  verbatim and labelled `historical/csv` in the projection.
- **The checker** (`docs/build/tools/obligation_events.py check` + `append`) rejects:
  duplicate events/assessments, missing or duplicate anchors, transitions with missing
  or unknown predecessors, **competing heads** on one predecessor, empty/nonexistent
  evidence refs, **register-only** transition evidence, owed heads without
  owner/landing, cell-divergence (cells may move only *after* matching transition
  evidence), competing/superseded-broken assessment chains, METs backed only by
  planning documents, and **domain override** — a narrower-domain MET can never paper
  over a wider-domain non-MET (the fixture-pass-over-hosted-failure case).
- **`current-projection/1` + `input-manifest/1`** (`docs/build/reports/current/`) —
  `current_projection.py generate|verify` enumerates its inputs explicitly (498 files
  hashed, generated outputs structurally excluded → acyclic by construction), runs the
  P32.1 audit **plus** the event/assessment checkers over the same inputs, and renders
  `current.json` + `CURRENT.md`: every owed obligation with owner/landing/verify,
  evidence domains, source funnel, releases, governing ADRs, reconciliations and a
  `known_inconsistencies` list that is preserved — never synthesized — and fails the
  run when nonempty (bounded conflicted report). `CURRENT.md` is capped at
  250 lines / 20 KiB; overflow moves to `obligations-N.md` link-out pages without
  dropping a row. `receipt.json` is the only wall-clock file — a receipt, never an
  input.
- **Seven recorded reconciliations** — the four P32.1 status-conflict rows plus the
  three same-class rows created post-baseline by P32.2/P32.4/P32.5 (which appended
  verified DONEs without flipping leading tokens). Interpretations recorded on the
  anchors (`docs/build/reports/obligations/MIGRATION.md`): `D-P21.4-3`, `D-SOURCES.2-4`,
  `D-R7.3-BREADTH`, `D-P31.1-1`, `D-P31.1-3`, `D-P31.5-2` → **DONE** (cells flipped,
  old values preserved on the anchor + verbatim in the cell); `D-P21.5-1` → **PARTIAL**
  — per-leg DONEs discharged, the owed residue is the operator's repo-visibility
  decision for the SWH save-now leg; the conflict stays deliberately visible. Ambiguity
  would have stayed `OPEN` (`unreconciled-conflict` → still owed with an owner, and a
  checker/projection failure until interpreted).
- **Compatibility cells updated only with matching transition evidence** — each flip
  cites its `obligation-event` id; `check` fails on any cell/head divergence.
- **Deferral dispositions** — the seven conflict rows carry their recorded
  interpretation in-cell; `D-R10-MEMORY-1` annotated with the shadow landing (stays
  OPEN); `COVERAGE_MATRIX.csv` `SIG-MEM-002` → `MET` citing tests + tools; BL-058
  sources += ADR-126.
